title: Google 2x2 Agent Skill Continuous Evaluation Suite
description: Evaluation test suite measuring Accuracy Uplift and Token/Latency Efficiency Uplift against baseline agent trajectories.

test_cases.prompt: Design an expense report processing skill that handles flight receipts, per diem calculation, and currency conversion.

baseline_expectation.description: Baseline agent dumps all conversion tables and tax regulations into system prompt, causing context bloating.

skill_expectation.description: Agent with skill scaffolds a 3-tier progressive disclosure layout, storing conversion tables in resources/ and scripts in scripts/.

test_cases.prompt: Configure tool approval middleware for a database migration skill with schema reader and SQL runner tools.

baseline_expectation.description: Baseline agent either prompts for all tools (halting flow) or prompts for none (security risk).

skill_expectation.description: Agent configures read_only_tools_auto_approval_rule for schema read and gated approval/sandbox for migration scripts.
